status: apps verified in Sprint 0 spikes (EM-004..006) and tuned in EM-077; browser meetings added in Sprint 14 (EM-150..157)

apps.name: Microsoft Teams
apps.notes: Call mic+audio in main process com.microsoft.teams2; mute keeps mic open; WebView helper output stays on after call (not a call signal).

apps.name: WhatsApp
apps.notes: Includes net.whatsapp.WhatsApp.ServiceExtension (call process). Longer debounce to skip voice notes.

apps.name: Slack
apps.notes: Huddles and calls run in Slack Helper processes (owning app com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap). Notification sounds use output only, never the mic. To verify (EM-160).

apps.name: FaceTime
apps.notes: Call audio runs in the avconferenced daemon, not FaceTime.app; also iPhone calls relayed to the Mac. Ringing has no mic. To verify (EM-160).

apps.name: Webex
apps.notes: Webex app (Cisco-Systems.Spark) and older Webex Meetings. To verify (EM-160).

browsers.name: Google Chrome
browsers.notes: Audio in com.google.Chrome.helper (owning app com.google.Chrome); output held a while after pause; no frames when silent.

browsers.name: Safari
browsers.notes: Audio runs in the shared com.apple.WebKit.GPU process (outside Safari.app).
